messages:
Maria H: Quick pre-oncall sanity run — I'm oncall Thu-Fri, want to confirm runbook access, VPN, pager test, and temp creds. Here's checklist:
- runbook access
- VPN / Okta
- pager receives test
- prod-readonly creds
- grafana dashboards load
Please reply with ✅ when done or mention blockers.

Josh L: ✅ Runbook link works for me (docs/runbooks/oncall.md). Confirmed I can SSH to jumpbox.

Anya P: VPN + Okta working. Ran script:
```bash
ssh -i ~/.ssh/redwood_jump ubuntu@jumpbox.redwood.internal
```
I got in.

Infra SRE: Grafana dashboards that matter: infra/latency, runtime/queues. I tested both and panels load.

Maria H: PagerDuty test in 30s — expect a call and push. If you don't get it, post here.

PagerDuty: Test Alert: "Oncall prep test" — triggered by Maria H — Escalation: infra-oncall -> eng-oncall

Josh L: got call + push, 1st response OK :thumbsup:

Anya P: didn't get call, only push. I cleared cache and re-registered. Trying again.

Maria H: @Anya P can you try re-enrolling: Settings -> Mobile -> Enable Calls. Also check carrier blocking. If still fail, list device model.

Anya P: re-enrolled, got call now. ✅

Maria H: For creds — I'm going to request temporary prod-readonly from Vault. @Josh L @Anya P please confirm you have Vault UI access so I can share path.

Josh L: I have vault read access to secret/data/oncall/prod-readonly.

Anya P: I can read but cannot list. Maria, share full path.

Maria H: Shared path: https://vault.redwood.com/ui/secret/data/oncall/prod-readonly. I rotated the token; don't paste tokens here :no_entry_sign: I'll DM the service account details.

Infra SRE: Quick smoke check you can run after creds: 
```bash
curl -sS https://api.redwood.prod/health | jq .status
```
expect "ok".

Maria H: Final note: runbook step 3 had an outdated pager number — updated the doc. Please open PRs if you spot anything else. I'll run a full dry-run tonight at 7pm PST and post results here. Thanks folks
